scope: Examples depend only on the published crates: control_layers (three rhythm layers, retained state, lifecycle, failure cleanup) and robot_apps on a simulated arm (two-layer control, MotionNode, System-created arm, planning in a hard rhythm beside a control loop, event-driven operator commands with guard, graph if and retry, dual-arm sideband). Hardware, real-time performance and foreign-language paths are not validated by these finite examples.
